2cd48c03de391dcdfe25c29240c97b979cdc9e93.summary: Louisiana state officials investigated a ransomware attack on the city of Alexandria, a city of about 50,000 people. The AlphV (also called BlackCat) gang listed the city as a victim. City officials said operations continued as scheduled, and state and federal agencies joined the response. The gang claimed it took more than 80 GB of data and threatened the governor and a media outlet. The FBI had tracked at least 60 attacks by the AlphV group as of March. The report says experts believe AlphV is a rebrand of BlackMatter and DarkSide.
